constants.name: default_command_port
constants.meaning: the command port without -p; the feedback port is the next one, unless -n is given

constants.name: connect_retry_ms
constants.meaning: how long the idle tick asks again for a connect a respawned worker could not make yet

constants.name: line_max
constants.meaning: the protocol socket's buffer: the longest pin_set line the daemon takes

constants.name: line_words_max
constants.meaning: the words of one command line the daemon reads, the verb included; a word past them is not read

constants.name: chain_members_min
constants.meaning: the fewest members of a chain: a chain of one is valid, so one isolated plugin is a chain like any other

worker_states.name: given-up
worker_states.meaning: the storm bound is spent for its placement

errors.name: PLACEMENT_INVALID
errors.meaning: placement invalid: not a placement, or not valid here, as a pool:<name> for a plugin of a format whose pin holds only in a world of the plugin's own, while require_pins is on

errors.name: NO_BACKEND
errors.meaning: no worker program for the scheme

errors.name: WORKER_SPAWN
errors.meaning: the worker is not up: the spawn failed, or it is in backoff; ask again after instance_restored

errors.name: REPLAY
errors.meaning: the name of a refused replay, never a reply: a replayed add that its pin or the worker refuses is announced by the instance_replay_refused event with the refusal's own code, and written to stderr with this one and the step that refused it

errors.name: GAVE_UP
errors.meaning: the storm bound is spent for that placement

errors.name: NO_SUCH_WORKER
errors.meaning: no such worker

errors.name: VERB_DROPPED
errors.meaning: the worker died on this very command and the daemon dropped it: it is not replayed, and the instance_verb_dropped event names it; or it died on, or did not answer in rpc_timeout_ms, the pin_expect of an add, which is then never forwarded

errors.name: PIN_ABSENT
errors.meaning: pin_mode strict and the plugin has no pin, or its layout pin is in a scheme this version does not know: add is refused and no worker sees it

errors.name: PIN_BINARY_MISMATCH
errors.meaning: a pinned file is missing or its SHA-256 differs, or the plugin's manifest names a file the pin does not hold: add is refused and no worker sees it

errors.name: PIN_LAYOUT_MISMATCH
errors.meaning: the worker found the parameter layout after init differs from the layout pin: the instance is destroyed before activate

errors.name: NO_PARAM_CONTRACT
errors.meaning: the host holds no checked unit and scale for this parameter: fall back to qualification

errors.name: LV2_ADAPTER_REFUSED
errors.meaning: the lv2-clap worker's LV2 adapter cannot run this plugin (MIDI it does not feed, a required feature it lacks, a layout it does not take): the worker answered the add -102, the lv2_adapter_refused event carries the hosting.* code of that reply, and under lv2_worker auto the plugin is run by the lv2 row instead and this code is never answered; a plugin no bundle of the worker's world holds is no refusal: the worker's -101 is answered

errors.name: NO_NOTE_INPUT
errors.meaning: the instance's plugin takes no notes (an effect): its worker answers note_on, note_off and all_notes_off with this code

errors.name: NOTES_BY_JACK
errors.meaning: the instance's worker takes no notes on its socket (mod-host): the daemon answers the note verbs and note_input with this code, and the plugin is played through its jack MIDI input with connect

errors.name: NO_PRESET_LIST
errors.meaning: the instance's worker cannot list the plugin's presets (mod-host): the daemon answers preset_list and preset_get with this code; preset_load still takes a preset the controller knows

errors.name: PIN_REFUSED
errors.meaning: the plugin's pin carries verdict=refused: its files are the ones that failed qualification, so add is refused and no worker sees it, and a replayed add is refused the same way; files that differ from the pin answer (-509) first. A pins_dir pin of that verdict is never overridden: pin_set and pin_accept of its plugin answer this code

errors.name: NOTE_QUEUE_FULL
errors.meaning: the instance's worker has no room for this note_on, note_off or all_notes_off before its next block: the line was not taken and nothing of it is kept; the controller may send it again

errors.name: CHAIN_UNKNOWN_INSTANCE
errors.meaning: a member of chain is an instance no add made: the chain is not declared

errors.name: CHAIN_DUPLICATE
errors.meaning: an instance is named twice in one chain: the chain is not declared

errors.name: CHAIN_INSTANCE_BUSY
errors.meaning: a member of chain is already in another chain: the chain is not declared; chain_clear of the other chain frees it

errors.name: CHAIN_MIXED_FORMAT
errors.meaning: the members of chain are not all run by one worker program, or are of two rows of one program and a row does not run chains in one client, so no one worker runs them: the chain is not declared

errors.name: NO_SUCH_CHAIN
errors.meaning: chain_clear or chain_get of a chain no chain declared

errors.name: PRESET_NOT_OFFERED
errors.meaning: the worker: preset_load or preset_show of a stable name the plugin does not offer, or of a plugin with no preset system and no state

errors.name: PRESET_INVALID
errors.meaning: preset_save with a file path that is not absolute or with no name, or preset_load or preset_show of a file that cannot be read, is no JSON, is of a format version other than org.openmixer.preset/1 and org.openmixer.preset/2, or breaks the format (docs/presets.md): the daemon answers it and no worker sees the file

errors.name: PRESET_NEEDS_STATE
errors.meaning: the worker: a preset file that carries state for a worker that cannot take state yet

errors.name: PRESET_PLUGIN_CHANGED
errors.meaning: the worker: the preset file's plugin id, version or fingerprint is not the instance's; nothing of it is applied

errors.name: LOAD_REFUSED
errors.meaning: the worker: the plugin refused the preset or the state its file carries

errors.name: DIR_NOT_WRITABLE
errors.meaning: descriptor_dir or qualification_dir cannot be made or written: the daemon does not start, and says which key and which path on stderr with this code; a directory that turns read-only later makes the scan of an add write nothing, and descriptor_get and panel_get of that plugin answer this code

errors.name: DESCRIPTOR_ABSENT
errors.meaning: descriptor_get (panel_get) of a plugin that has no descriptor (panel) in descriptor_dir for its binary as it is now, and none being written: no add since it changed, or a binary that cannot be found

errors.name: DESCRIPTOR_PENDING
errors.meaning: descriptor_get (panel_get) of a plugin whose scan, started by its add, has not written its descriptor (panel) yet: ask again

errors.name: DESCRIPTOR_SCAN_FAILED
errors.meaning: descriptor_get (panel_get) of a plugin whose last scan wrote no descriptor (panel): the scanner refused the plugin, made no dump or no panel, or is not installed; the add it ran for stands, and stderr and the scan's log say why. The next add scans again

verbs.name: add
verbs.meaning: mod-host's add with a placement; a token after the instance that is not a placement is the jack client name

verbs.name: instance_info
verbs.meaning: where an instance lives and what it has cost

verbs.name: supervisor_reset
verbs.meaning: re-arm the storm bound and the backoff of a given-up placement

verbs.name: quarantine_clear
verbs.meaning: let a quarantined instance go back where its placement says

verbs.name: policy_set
verbs.meaning: the placement of an add that says default

verbs.name: pool_config
verbs.meaning: the instances a pool holds before a sibling opens

verbs.name: worker_env
verbs.meaning: the cpu list and the nice value of the workers of a format, at spawn and on the ones running

verbs.name: pin_set
verbs.meaning: the pin of one plugin: the SHA-256 of every file the host loads for it, a path relative to the bundle (the directory of a single-file format's file), its layout fingerprint and, when it is known, the verdict of its qualification; it replaces an earlier pin of the uri; -516 for a plugin whose pins_dir pin carries verdict=refused, which nothing overrides. The pin store, a pin_file and a pins_dir file hold the same line, with or without the verb

verbs.name: pin_clear
verbs.meaning: forget the pin of one plugin, or of every one; a pins_dir pin is read-only and holds again

verbs.name: lv2_worker_set
verbs.meaning: the worker of one LV2 plugin, for its adds from now on: it overrides the lv2_worker setting, - takes the override back; -902 for a word that is none of these. Like policy_set it is the controller's, not in the ledger, gone with the daemon

verbs.name: pin_accept
verbs.meaning: pin_mode first-use only: take the plugin's files as they are now as its pin, after a pin_changed event; the layout is learned again by the next add and the verdict is dropped; -508 when the plugin has no pin, -509 when its files cannot be collected, -516 when its pins_dir pin carries verdict=refused, -902 under pin_mode strict

verbs.name: pin_layout
verbs.meaning: sent by the daemon to a worker of a format that checks layouts, after it accepted the add of a plugin whose layout pin is still unknown: the layout the worker found after init, which the daemon records in the pin

verbs.name: pin_expect
verbs.meaning: sent by the daemon to a worker of a format that checks layouts, just before the instance's add: the layout pin that add checks after init and before activate; any other reply than resp 0 refuses the add with that code, and the add is never forwarded

verbs.name: chain
verbs.meaning: the instances, in this order, are one chain, run in one worker of place chain:<chain>: each member's state is saved, it is removed from the worker it was in and replayed in the chain's. A chain already declared takes the new order, and a member left out of it goes back to a worker of its own; while its worker is up that worker is kept: a new member joins it (its add, the order, its state, its ledger, its connections) and no other member is restarted, unless the new member's format narrows the worker's world, which forms the chain again. Members of clap and lv2-clap form one chain. A worker that runs chains in one client (clap, lv2-clap) is sent this line, with the members it holds, after the adds of its replay; one that does not (mod-host) never is, and a refusal of it is written to stderr and is no failure. Every instance verb still names one member by its own number. A member that crashes the worker is quarantined to a worker of its own and the chain goes on without it; quarantine_clear puts it back. -518 for an instance no add made, -519 for one named twice, -520 for one in another chain, -521 for members no one worker program runs together, -501 for a plugin that may not share a worker while require_pins is on (a CLAP plugin whose first-use pin is not in-process; an LV2 member whose bundle is not found, since a chain's worker sees a world narrowed to the union of its members' bundles), -902 for a chain or an instance that is not a number, or fewer than chain_members_min (1) instances

verbs.name: chain_clear
verbs.meaning: forget the chain: each member goes to a worker of its own; -522 for a chain no chain declared

verbs.name: chain_get
verbs.meaning: read a chain back: its worker (- when it has none), its members in the declared order, and the members its worker runs now in their order (- for none); a quarantined member is declared and not running; -522 for a chain no chain declared, -902 for a chain that is not a number

verbs.name: descriptor_get
verbs.meaning: the scanned descriptor of the plugin, answered from descriptor_dir: the file named for its binary as it is now (<id>@<version>-<hash>.json), written by the scan the plugin's add ran. -529 when there is none, -530 while its scan runs, -531 when its last scan wrote nothing, -528 when the directory could not be written

verbs.name: panel_get
verbs.meaning: the panel the plugin publishes (org.openmixer.panel-description/1), answered from descriptor_dir: the file panels/<id>@<version>-<hash>.json, named as its descriptor, which the same scan writes once the descriptor is in place, {"plugin": {"format", "id"}, "panel": <the panel object omx-clap-scan --json prints for the plugin, null when it serves none>}; an LV2 plugin's panel is null. The codes are descriptor_get's: -529 when there is none, -530 while its scan runs, -531 when its last scan wrote nothing, -528 when the directory could not be written

instance_verbs.name: track_info
instance_verbs.meaning: the strip's name ("" for none), colour and kind, absent for an input channel; a worker whose plugin format has a track-info extension passes them on; any other word is -902

instance_verbs.name: remote_pages
instance_verbs.meaning: the plugin's remote-control pages, from clap.remote-controls; 0 for an instance of a format whose worker has none

instance_verbs.name: remote_page_get
instance_verbs.meaning: one page, 0 to count - 1: each slot the symbol param_set takes, - for an empty one; -902 for a page that is not one

instance_verbs.name: param_info
instance_verbs.meaning: what a parameter's value means: its unit, its scale, and the symbol it keeps across hosts and versions; -103 for a symbol that is not a parameter, the plugin's own bypass and :bypass included; -511 for a parameter whose unit and scale the worker holds no checked contract for

instance_verbs.name: preset_list
instance_verbs.meaning: the plugin's presets, the ones its preset discovery or its bundle lists; (-515) for an instance of a worker that cannot list them

instance_verbs.name: preset_get
instance_verbs.meaning: one preset, 0 to count - 1: the key preset_load takes for it, and its name; -902 for an index that is not one

instance_verbs.name: note_input
instance_verbs.meaning: whether the instance takes notes: the name of its note input on its worker's jack client, - for a plugin that takes none; (-514) for an instance of a worker that cannot say

instance_verbs.name: note_on
instance_verbs.meaning: play a key: channel 0 to 15, key 0 to 127, velocity 1 to 127, a MIDI note on at the start of the worker's next cycle; (-513) for a plugin that takes no notes, (-514) for an instance of a worker that takes none on its socket, -902 for a word out of its range

instance_verbs.name: note_off
instance_verbs.meaning: release a key, velocity 0 to 127, a MIDI note off; answered as note_on is

instance_verbs.name: all_notes_off
instance_verbs.meaning: release every key of every channel, MIDI's all notes off (controller 123) on each; answered as note_on is

host_profiles.name: lv2-worker
host_profiles.meaning: an LV2 plugin's worker: mod-host, or omx-clap-host's LV2 adapter

host_profiles.name: console
host_profiles.meaning: the openmixer console as a controller of the daemon

host_profiles.name: zynthian
host_profiles.meaning: Zynthian's mod-ui and its plugind engine as a controller of the daemon

param_scales.name: linear
param_scales.meaning: the value is linear in position

param_scales.name: log
param_scales.meaning: the value is geometric in position; both bounds are positive

param_scales.name: stepped
param_scales.meaning: the whole numbers from min to max, step 1

events.name: worker_died
events.meaning: a worker died; the instances it held, or - for none

events.name: instance_verb_dropped
events.meaning: the command a worker died on, dropped from the ledger; or the add it died on, the add as the worker was given it, which names the plugin, or the pin_expect of that add

events.name: instance_verb_dropped
events.meaning: the last verb a worker answered when it died inside suspect_window_ms, <ms> the age of the reply

events.name: worker_respawned
events.meaning: a worker is back and its ledger replayed

events.name: instance_restored
events.meaning: an instance is back in a worker

events.name: instance_replay_refused
events.meaning: a replayed add was refused, by its pin or by the worker, <code> the refusal's own: no worker holds the instance until the next replay

events.name: instance_quarantined
events.meaning: the culprit of a pool or a chain death, placed own until cleared; a chain goes on without it

events.name: chain_formed
events.meaning: a chain's worker is up with these members, in this order, after its declaration, a respawn or a member's quarantine; - for none

events.name: supervisor_gave_up
events.meaning: the storm bound is spent; respawning ends

events.name: pin_changed
events.meaning: an add or a replay of a plugin was refused because its files, or the layout the worker found, differ from its pin; the pin is as it was until pin_accept or pin_set

events.name: lv2_adapter_refused
events.meaning: the LV2 adapter of the lv2-clap worker refused a plugin: <reason> is the hosting.* code after -102 on the worker's reply to that add (- when it named none); the last word is the lv2_worker in force, auto for a plugin the lv2 row runs from now on, omx-clap-host for an add answered (-512)

events.name: remote_pages_changed
events.meaning: relayed from a worker: the plugin changed its remote pages; read them again

events.name: remote_page_suggest
events.meaning: relayed from a worker: the plugin suggests the remote page of that id (a page_id of remote_page_get); a surface may follow it

events.name: param_gesture
events.meaning: relayed from a worker: the user took hold of a control of the plugin's own, or let it go; a controller writes no automation of that parameter in between. The values the plugin moves meanwhile, or at any time by itself, are mod-host's param_set feedback lines, relayed as written. A gesture whose worker died, or whose instance was removed, before its end is ended by the daemon, before the worker_died event

events.name: param_set
events.meaning: relayed from a worker: parameter feedback, a value the plugin moved by itself (its automation, an LFO, a preset load, a MIDI map, the user's knob of the plugin's own), as mod-host writes it; a controller updates its control to it. A worker never writes it for a value a controller's param_set gave it, and a worker that writes none changes nothing: the daemon adds no line of its own

pin_limits.name: PATH
pin_limits.meaning: a path holding ',', '=' or whitespace cannot be pinned: they are the separators of pin_set's words, and pin_set refuses it as a token outside its grammar

pin_limits.name: LINE
pin_limits.meaning: a pin_set line is at most line_max, 4096 bytes, the protocol socket's buffer; a longer one is refused as outside the grammar

pin_limits.name: MANIFEST
pin_limits.meaning: a manifest that uses @base, or names a file of the plugin by a percent-encoded IRI, makes add answer PHD_ERR_PIN_BINARY_MISMATCH (-509): the daemon does not resolve either, so it cannot know the file the host would load

rules.name: VERBATIM
rules.meaning: every line a worker writes on its feedback port goes out on the daemon's feedback port as the worker wrote it: output_set, param_set, data_finish and the rest of mod-host's feedback, and a line the daemon does not know

rules.name: INSTANCE
rules.meaning: the instance number in a relayed line is already the controller's: add hands it to the worker unchanged, so nothing in a line is rewritten

rules.name: ORDER
rules.meaning: a worker's lines go out in the order it wrote them, and what a worker wrote before it died goes out before its worker_died event; an instance lives in one worker at a time, so its lines keep their order across a respawn; the lines of different workers interleave

rules.name: SUBSCRIPTION
rules.meaning: monitor_output is in the ledger, one line per output, and param_monitor as it was sent; a respawn replays them after the add, so a respawned instance reports the same outputs, each once, starting again from its first value

rules.name: HANDSHAKE
rules.meaning: output_data_ready names no instance and goes to every worker; each worker's data_finish is relayed

rules.name: NO_CONTROLLER
rules.meaning: with no feedback port, or no controller on it, a line is dropped, as mod-host drops it; the daemon reads every worker's feedback all the time, so no worker waits on it

host_settings.name: TEMPO
host_settings.meaning: the tempo, the metre and the transport a controller sets (mod-host's set_bpm, set_bpb, transport and transport_sync) are kept, the latest line of each as it was sent, in the order they were last sent

host_settings.name: REPLAY
host_settings.meaning: a worker is handed them before anything else: a respawned one before its first add, and a worker started later, of a new placement, as well; a worker's refusal of one is written to stderr and is no failure

host_settings.name: GRAMMAR
host_settings.meaning: a line whose words are not that command's grammar is passed on and not kept

config.meaning: worker for lv2 (a name on PATH or a path)
worker for clap

who runs an LV2 plugin: mod-host (the mod_host program), omx-clap-host (the clap_host program, through its LV2 adapter, a plugin it cannot run refused with a code) or auto (the adapter first, mod-host for what it refuses, each such plugin in a worker of its own unless its add names a placement); lv2_worker_set overrides it for one plugin
where bundles are searched
the daemon's checkpoints and worker logs
strict or first-use, while require_pins is 1: first-use records the pin of a plugin on its first add, strict admits only a plugin a controller, a pin_file or pins_dir pinned
the file first-use pins are kept in; empty is $XDG_STATE_HOME/plugin-hostd/pins, else $HOME/.local/state/plugin-hostd/pins
a file of pin lines loaded at start, as plugin-qualify --all --pins writes it; empty is none

the read-only pins of packages: every file in it whose name ends in .pins, read at start in name order, under the store, the pin_file and pin_set, except that a pin of verdict=refused there always holds; empty is none

the scanned descriptors, one file per plugin binary (<id>@<version>-<hash>.json, the hash the binary's SHA-256), written by the scan of an add and read by descriptor_get; empty is $XDG_STATE_HOME/omx/descriptors, else /var/lib/omx/descriptors run as root (a system service), else $HOME/.local/state/omx/descriptors; its variable is for tests only

plugin-qualify's qualification records (verdict, cost, version tested), kept apart from the descriptors; empty is $XDG_STATE_HOME/omx/qualification, else /var/lib/omx/qualification run as root (a system service), else $HOME/.local/state/omx/qualification; its variable is for tests only
the scanner an add runs, as <probe> describe <target>, in a child of its own once per plugin binary; its stdout is the descriptor
a worker that does not accept in this long is a failed spawn
a worker that does not answer in this long is killed
respawn backoff, doubling per death in the window
the most a respawn backoff grows to
deaths inside the window that end respawning of a placement
the window storm_deaths are counted in
a worker that dies this soon after a reply drops the verb it answered; 0 turns it off
a quiet interval with a changed ledger writes a checkpoint
the period of the idle tick: reap, respawn, checkpoint
instances in a pool before a sibling opens

1: add admits only a plugin that has a pin (see pin_mode), its files hashed before any worker sees it, and a plugin of a format whose pin holds only in a world of its own gets a worker of its own, its world the plugin's files (a default that resolves to a pool is placed own); 0: no pin is checked
